notes: Three things at once. (1) '09/07/2026' from a Manchester vendor is DD/MM = 9 July 2026 — the mirror of globex-2291. (2) Line items are split across two side-by-side blocks, so there is no single top-to-bottom reading order; this is the document that argues for multimodal input over pre-OCR. (3) The volume discount (-46.80) and fuel surcharge (62.00) are in the totals block, so they are NOT line items. Consequence for Week 2: sum(lineItems) = 936.00 but total = 1141.44, so the arithmetic check must model discount + surcharge + VAT rather than comparing the line sum straight to the total. Vendor letterhead is CSS-uppercased; title-cased per convention.
